city.category: Assisted native HTTP city/facade/interior integration using actual installed geographic sources.
city.originalScope:
Assisted native-browser contracts for the installed Marseille city atlas.

The exact production HTML, real GameHandler, city partitions, terrain, source
hashes, UI and browser storage are used. Existing diagnostic APIs load sectors,
place a camera on measured clear ground and pause simulation/rendering. They do
not fabricate buildings, substitute HTTP, inject HTML or grant a documentary
plan. Portal, landing and container actions use actual keyboard/UI controls.
This is a bounded integration pilot, not an unassisted citywide playthrough.

restore.category: Fresh real-archive restoration and HTTP validation under Python standard library; no rendering claim.
restore.originalScope:
Restore the shipped REAL Marseille archive into an empty temporary directory.

This verifies archive restoration, every runtime byte and the production HTTP
audit, including immediate corruption detection. It does not certify rendering
or an unassisted playthrough. No remote acquisition or synthetic map is used.

roads.category: Targeted assisted native road geometry/visual regression; historical before capture is identified separately.
roads.originalScope: Native final production HTML, real installed city sources and unchanged measured camera. Existing diagnostic APIs pause rendering/simulation, load the real sector and read geometry; browser receives no injected HTML, network mocks or synthetic geography. The targeted correction preserves raw sourceXYZ while deriving only eligible at-grade IGN ribbons from the MNT used by physics. This is a regression diagnostic at one location, not a citywide visual certification.

historicalReportsExcludedFromFinalQa.scope: Native unchanged production HTML over real local HTTP, actual installed city sources and measured camera. Only existing diagnostic APIs load sectors, place the camera and pause continuous simulation/rendering. Read-only production geometry is queried with diagnostic rays; no HTML or network mocks. The after run is a targeted visual/classification regression and does not certify the final terrain-index snapshot or a human citywide playthrough.
historicalReportsExcludedFromFinalQa.role: Historical intermediate road policy, preserved verbatim; superseded by the current final diagnostic.

limits: One-to-one metric source coordinates and exhaustive acquisition coverage do not guarantee sub-metre survey accuracy.
Unknown facade details and interior plans remain explicitly invented coherent game content; source footprints and storey attributes are not measured room plans.
Native pilots retain diagnostic scene/camera/story assistance and software Chromium limitations declared in the original reports.
Historical before/intermediate regression captures carry their original older HTML identity and are never final-build evidence.
Remote request failures retained in native reports are observations; successful bounded local tests do not certify remote-service availability.
Source acquisition/replay audits validate actual geographic bytes separately from browser and gameplay checks.

supplementaryEvidenceExcludedFromFinalQa.scope: Pure adapter reproducibility and missing/repeated-pattern refusal checks. Fifteen generated scripts match the successful final legacy execution; these checks are separate from gameplay and excluded from the QA total.
